items.title: 8.2 AI systems ke saqafati aur akhlaqi asraat (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) logon ke rehne, kaam karne aur technology se taalluq par asar dalti hai, is liye is ke cultural (saqafati) aur ethical (akhlaqi) asraat ko dekhna zaroori hai. AI systems sirf technical cheezein nahi, balke samaji tools bhi hain jo logon, bastiyon (communities) aur hukoomaton par asar dalte hain (Figure 8.5).

blocks.alt: Darmiyani daira 'AI system' chaar stakeholders se jura: developers (durust, munsif systems), users (asani, raazdari, durust nataij), hukoomatein (qawaneen, awami mafad) aur biradariyan (samaji aur saqafati aqdar). Neeche patti usool: insaf (imtiyaz nahi), jawabdehi (koi zimmedar), shaffafiyat (faisle samjhaye ja sakein) aur hifazat (users ko nuqsan nahi).
blocks.caption: Figure 8.5: Akhlaqi AI design mukhtalif stakeholders ke mafadat mein tawazun rakhta hai aur insaf aur shamooliyat yaqeeni banata hai (kitab ki Figure 8.5 par apna khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Akhlaqi design ka matlab chaaron groups ka tawazun hai, sirf system banane ya paisa dene walon ka nahi.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Mubahisa (debate): “Kya AI ko aise faisle karne chahiye jo logon ki zindagi par asar dalein, jaise naukri ke liye bharti ya talaba ko grade dena?”
AI systems ke stakeholders

AI systems mein kai stakeholders (woh log ya idare jin par asar parta hai ya jo hissa lete hain) hote hain, aur har ek in ke banne aur istemal mein aham kirdar ada karta hai. Developers AI models design aur program karte hain, users rozmarra kaamon mein inhein use karte hain, hukoomatein in ke istemal ke qawaid banati hain, aur communities in ka asar mehsoos karti hain. Har group AI ke poore nizam (ecosystem) mein hissa dalta aur us ki tarakki par asar dalta hai.

Developers: Developers AI systems design aur tayyar karte hain aur un ke kaam, nayi ijaad aur performance par dhyan dete hain. Woh yaqeeni banate hain ke systems durust, munsifana aur akhlaqi tareeqe se bane hon.
Users: Users AI systems use karte hain aur chahte hain ke yeh aasan aur qabil-e-bharosa hon. Unhein privacy (raazdari), hifazat aur durust nataij ki fikr hoti hai.
Hukoomatein (governments): Hukoomatein AI ke mehfooz aur munsifana istemal ke liye policies aur qawaid banati hain. Woh awam ke mafadat ki hifazat karti aur qanoon par amal karwati hain.
Communities (bastiyan): Communities samaji aqdar (values) aur saqafati riwayat bachane par dhyan deti hain, aur muashre mein AI ke zimmedarana aur akhlaqi istemal ko farogh deti hain.
Saqafati shaoor aur tanawwo (diversity)

Saqafati tanawwo is par asar dalta hai ke duniya bhar mein AI systems kaise design kiye, samjhe aur lagaye jate hain. Saqafati aqdar privacy, baat-cheet ke andaz aur technology apnane ke baare mein users ki tawaqqo ko mutasir karti hain. Designers ko maqami riwayat aur rawaiyon ka khayal rakhna chahiye taake AI tools mukhtalif saqafaton ke liye qabil-e-rasai aur ehtram wale hon.

Maslan privacy ki pasand ilaqon ke hisab se mukhtalif hai: kuch muashre data share karne mein aaram mehsoos karte hain, jab ke kuch sakht raazdari chahte hain. Language models mein mukhtalif zabanein aur lehje (dialects) shamil hone chahiye taake taqatwar saqafaton ki taraf jhukao (bias) na ho. Isi tarah AI ke faisle maqami rasm-o-riwaj aur samaji usoolon ka khayal rakhein taake woh munsifana aur qabil-e-qabool hon.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Jo AI mukhtalif zabanein aur saqafatein samajhti hai woh har pas-e-manzar ke logon ki behtar khidmat kar sakti hai.
AI ke akhlaqi usool
AI systems mein insaf, jawabdehi, transparency aur hifazat

Akhlaqi AI banane ke liye chaar cheezein zaroori hain: fairness (insaf) taake discrimination na ho, accountability (jawabdehi) taake zimmedari tay ho, transparency (shaffafiyat) taake samjhaya ja sake ke system faisle kaise karta hai, aur safety (hifazat) taake users ko nuqsan na pohanche. Maslan agar AI system talaba ke admission ke liye use ho to woh jins (gender), ilaqe, zaban ya pas-e-manzar ki buniyad par kisi talib ko na-insafi se tarjeeh ya radd na kare. University ko yeh bhi batana aana chahiye ke talib kyun chuna ya radd hua, aur agar system ghalat faisla kare to zimmedar kaun hai. Isi tarah sehat mein beemari pehchanne wala AI system ehtiyat se test kiya jaye taake woh nuqsan deh ya gumraah-kun nataij na de. Yeh usool AI ko insanon ke faide ka tool rakhte hain aur anjane bure nataij se bachate hain.
AI design mein bias se bachna aur shamooliyat (inclusivity)

AI systems aksar bare datasets se seekhte hain jin mein chhupa hua bias ho sakta hai. Maslan agar bharti ka system zyada tar aise purane records par train ho jin mein mard auraton se zyada chune gaye, to AI mard umeedwaron ko na-insafi se tarjeeh de sakti hai. Isi tarah agar chehra pehchanne wala system zyada tar ek umar, ek rang (skin tone) ya ek ilaqe ki tasveeron par train ho to doosre groups ke logon ke liye kharab kaam kar sakta hai. Developers ko yeh datasets ghaur se dekh kar theek karne chahiye taake kisi fard ya group se na-insafi na ho. AI design mein inclusivity (sab ko shamil karna) ka matlab mukhtalif nazariye shamil karna aur yaqeeni banana hai ke technology jins, nasal ya pas-e-manzar se qata-e-nazar sab ki barabar khidmat kare.
Stakeholders ke mafadat ka takrao

Jab stakeholders ki tarjeehat mukhtalif hon to takrao (conflict) paida hota hai. Karobar nayi ijaad aur munafe ke liye data jama karna chahte hain, jab ke users apni zaati maloomat ki privacy aur us par ikhtiyar chahte hain. Hukoomaton ko maeeshat ki tarakki aur shehriyon ke huqooq ki hifazat aur akhlaqi miyar mein tawazun rakhna hota hai.

Takrao ki aam misaal data jama karne ka tareeqa hai. Companies AI ki performance behtar karne ke liye users ka bohat sa data jama kar sakti hain, lekin wazeh ijazat (explicit consent) ke baghair yeh privacy aur bharose ki khilaf-warzi hai. Shaffaf data policies aur aasan ijazat ke tareeqe kaam aur akhlaqiyat mein munsifana tawazun laate hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Privacy aur nayi ijaad mein tawazun aaj ki technology wali duniya ke sab se bare challenges mein se ek hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Company ki meeting ka role-play karein jis mein developers user data jama karna chahte hain aur privacy ke hami (advocates) is ki mukhalifat karte hain. Hal par baat karein.
Policy aur qanooni dhaanche (legal frameworks)

Kai bain-ul-aqwami (international) dhaanche AI ke zimmedarana istemal ki rehnumai karte hain. European Union ka General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) data privacy aur users ke huqooq par sakht qawaid lagu karta hai. Duniya bhar ke idaron ke banaye AI Ethics Guidelines jawabdehi, insaf aur insani izzat ke ehtram par zor dete hain. Yeh dhaanche mulkon aur companies ko zimmedarana AI apnane ki targheeb dete hain.

Pakistan ke liye qaumi AI policies banana zaroori hai taake nayi ijaad bhi ho aur akhlaqi usoolon ki pabandi bhi. Aisi policies data ki hifazat ke qawaid bana sakti, research ki hosla-afzai kar sakti, aur aise AI hal banane mein madad de sakti hain jo maqami aqdar aur zarooraton ke mutabiq hon. Akhlaqi miyar lagu karne se awam ka bharosa banta hai, bain-ul-aqwami shirakat milti hai, aur AI mulk ki tarakki mein musbat hissa dalti hai.

blocks.title: Pakistan ki AI policy
blocks.text: Pakistan ki wafaqi hukoomat ne 2025 mein National Artificial Intelligence Policy manzoor ki. Is ki taaza tafseelat ke liye sarkari dastavezat dekhein.

blocks.prompt: AI talaba ke mazameen check karti aur dehi schools ke talaba ke saadi English mein likhe jawabon ko kam number deti hai. Kaun se akhlaqi usool khatre mein hain, aur kya karna chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Insaf (aik group ke khilaf bias) aur shaffafiyat (talaba nahi dekh sakte ke number kyun kam hain), aur nataij ki jawabdehi. Training data bias ke liye jaancha jaye, number asatiza dekhein, scoring samjhai jaye, aur istemal se pehle system bohat si qism ke schools ke mazameen par test ho.

items: Stakeholders: developers, users, hukoomatein, communities; har ek ki alag fikr.
